title: Women's Christmas – Cat Allegedly. Crewneck Sweatshirt

seo.title: Cat Christmas Sweater: Allegedly. Crewneck
seo.description: A funny cat Christmas sweater: a smug tuxedo cat beside a smashed ornament, ALLEGEDLY. 8 oz fleece crewneck, S-3XL, free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

Cat Allegedly. is the Christmas crewneck for the cat person whose tuxedo cat sits beside a shattered ornament looking smug, and it is the only cat Christmas sweater that lets the cat plead the fifth. Wear it to the holiday dinner or the tree-trimming, where the evidence is everywhere and the suspect has an alibi.

The print shows a black-and-cream tuxedo cat licking a raised paw beside a smashed red ornament on a braided red, cream and mustard rug, with a pine sprig and red berries behind it, and ALLEGEDLY. in red slab capitals underneath.

Wear it to the tree-trimming, a cozy night in with the cats or Christmas morning, or give it to the cat owner who has stopped buying glass ornaments. Printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

What is the Cat Allegedly. crewneck?
It is a women's Christmas crewneck sweatshirt from Graphic Tees Co. showing a smug black-and-white cat beside a shattered red ornament on a braided rug, lettered ALLEGEDLY. It is a Gildan 18000 in 8 oz cotton-poly fleece, so it works as the cat person's Christmas sweater.

How does the crewneck fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. crewneck is a classic unisex sweatshirt cut in sizes S through 3XL with a ribbed neck, cuffs and waistband. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up one for a roomier, cozier look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

How do I wash it so the print lasts?
Wash your Cat Allegedly. crewneck inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz, so it holds its shape, and the red lettering and black-and-cream cat stay crisp through a whole season of wear.

Is it a good gift for a cat person?
Yes. It suits the cat owner who knows exactly who broke the ornament, and it is an easy gift from family or friends. It is $34.99 from Graphic Tees Co. in Sand and Navy, and the free size exchange within 30 days makes it safe to give.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Cat Allegedly. crewneck should arrive before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
